notes: Tail case re-examined on the clean source. U1 mask was the whole scooter rider; now his navy-and-yellow plaid shirt (SAM3, v2). U2 replace was a recolour; now the parked black bicycle is replaced by a red kick scooter, ref names the utility pole. U3 removed the scooter the U1 man sits on (coupled pair); retargeted to the independent white hand-painted Hindi sign board on the stall at the right (SAM3, v2). U4 ref names the blue OXEMBERG billboard; payload made specific and different from the sign colour.

difficulty.evidence_zh: 骑踏板车男子的格子衬衫、电线杆后停放的黑色自行车、右侧摊位上的白色手写招牌和左上方蓝色OXEMBERG广告牌是四个不同对象。
difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留人物、车辆、摊位和街头标识。

spec.ref: the navy-and-yellow plaid shirt of the man riding the white scooter

units.ref_zh: 骑白色踏板车男子的藏青黄格子衬衫
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将骑白色踏板车男子的藏青黄格子衬衫的颜色改为红色。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为红色。
preserve: 保留男子的头部、牛仔裤和踏板车。
units.reason: Mask covered the whole man; now only his plaid shirt (navy/yellow on the clean source, so red is a clear change).

spec.ref: the black bicycle parked behind the utility pole at the upper right

units.ref_zh: 右上方电线杆后停放的黑色自行车
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右上方电线杆后停放的黑色自行车替换为一辆红色滑板车。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一辆红色滑板车。
units.reason: 'red bicycle' was only a recolour; a kick scooter is a structural replacement. Ref distinguishes it from the cycle-cart wheel under the stall at the far right.

spec.ref: the white hand-painted Hindi sign board on the stall at the right

units.ref_zh: 右侧摊位上的白色手写印地语招牌
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除右侧摊位上的白色手写印地语招牌。
units.reason: Removing the scooter would leave the U1 rider floating; retargeted to the independent sign board (no overlap with other units).

spec.ref: the blue OXEMBERG billboard at the upper left

units.instruction_ref_zh: 在左上方的蓝色OXEMBERG广告牌上加一个红色小圆形标志。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 在选中区域上加一个红色小圆形标志。
units.reason: 'a blue logo' on a blue billboard was vague and low-contrast; ref names the billboard by its text.
